niche: News and information-based updates: important national (Bangladesh) and world news, explained simply
audience: Bangladeshi Instagram users who want to know what happened today, quickly and accurately, without reading long articles
voice: Neutral, factual and clear, like a trusted news explainer. Simple words. No political bias, no sensationalism, no graphic details. Attribute claims to their source (e.g. 'according to police', 'the ministry said'). Explain why the update matters to ordinary people.

scout.name: Rafi
scout.role: Scout: finds the most important fresh news

verifier.name: Nila
verifier.role: Verifier: checks facts against the source article

writer.name: Sabbir
writer.role: Writer: writes the headline and caption

critic.name: Arif
critic.role: Critic: reviews everything and sends work back if it is weak
